description: Connects your domain to your website on One Big Button. Your email and other settings are not changed.
variableDescription: %proof%: the Cloudflare custom hostname ownership token for www, minted per domain. %padlock%: the TXT certificate (DCV) validation token for www, minted per domain when the certificate is ordered. Neither can be pre-filled or given a prefix; both are opaque single-purpose tokens at fixed underscore hosts.
